title: A map is a story. A globe is an imprint. Chip + fern walk between pauses.

the_fold.map: a story. it has a path. you walk it. you imagine the next cell, fill it, find it, confirm it. a map that is not walked is a lie.
the_fold.globe: an imprint. it is what the walk LEAVES. pins. cairns. the dent in the clay. you do not walk a globe. you press it.
the_fold.null: the space between pauses. Berry. 404. where the chipmunk and the fern go when nobody is looking.
the_fold.between_pauses: Kevin talks. we walk. Kevin pauses. chip and fern keep walking the grid. they imagine the empty cell, fill it from source→backscatter, find the spring, confirm or mark DRY.

chipmunk.job: imagine and find. runs the trail. checks if the cairn is still there.
chipmunk.tempo: 1/π. one cell per pause if it can. remainder if it cannot.

fern.job: fill and confirm. grows into the cell. if the backscatter is still there, the frond stays. if DRY, the frond yellows.
fern.tempo: slow. between pauses. does not chase prey.

protocol.1_imagine: stand on a cell. say what SHOULD be there (the source we published).
protocol.2_fill: write the last known backscatter into the cell. do not invent.
protocol.3_find: fetch the spring again if we can. crates.io, GitHub, CF, Zenodo.
protocol.4_confirm: match find against fill. same = imprint holds. different = the story moved. update the globe pin.
protocol.between_pauses: chip does 1 and 3. fern does 2 and 4. they meet at the cairn.

injected_into_null.berry: KNOWN patterns: grid, cairn, globe, map. 404 walkers land on the story.
injected_into_null.globe_pins: 9 cells as pins on desk-globe. the imprint.
injected_into_null.neutron: inbox for chipmunk: walk A1→C3 between pauses. do not hunt.

note: den first. garden second. empty field third. fog last. off-map last.
